description: @font-face: a family declared by the author, with an src chain whose unsupported woff2 candidate is skipped and whose next candidate is loaded, and a second rule supplying the real bold face. The faces are carried by the corpus, so the Fixture asserts the same thing on any machine; the local() form of src is covered by the unit tests instead. Assertions use embedded face names: glyph ids in the content streams are not searchable as text.
visual_assertions: Heading and body render in the declared serif face, not Helvetica.
The bold span uses the real bold face from the second @font-face rule, not synthesized strokes.
The last paragraph (undeclared family) falls back to the document font.
